quizzes.question_text: Find the missing number to complete the proportion. 48 cookies on 3 packages = 32 cookies on packages=_
solution: Set up the proportion as fractions: $\frac{48 \text{ cookies}}{3 \text{ packages}} = \frac{32 \text{ cookies}}{_\_ \text{ packages}}$
Notice that 32 cookies is a fraction of 48 cookies. So we need the same proportion of 3 packages: $3 \times \frac{32}{48} = 2$
The answer is 2 packages. Check: $\frac{48}{3} = \frac{32}{2}$ both equal 16 cookies per 1 package.
